title: Career Transition Suite
subtitle: Pivot Risk Scorer + Skill Match Analyzer
data_vintage: User-entered inputs only — no embedded reference data. Zero maintenance requirement.
downstream_handoff_note: AL-28 Career Break & Reentry Cost Engine is proposed — handoff is conditional on Apex Advisors approval.

mcp_tool_definition.name: assess_career_transition
mcp_tool_definition.description: Score a career pivot's risk using a composite model (financial runway, salary delta, skill proximity, market demand) and generate a weighted skill gap analysis against a target role. Returns two Policy-Mandate-compliant mandates: career_pivot_assessment and career_transition_record.

target_salary_usd.description: Expected annual salary in target role, USD.

liquid_savings_usd.description: Liquid savings available as financial runway, USD.

skill_proximity_rating.description: Self-rated skill proximity to target role (1 = very different, 5 = closely aligned).

market_demand_rating.description: Self-rated market demand for target role (1 = weak, 5 = strong).

skill_inventory.description: Skill inventory for Tab 2 analysis (up to 12 skills).
